question: Using the linear approximation of $f(x)=\sqrt{x}$ about $x=36$, estimate $\sqrt{36.5}$ correct to four decimal places.
explanation:
Linear approximation formula
For $x$ close to $a$,
$$f(x)\approx f(a)+f'(a)(x-a)$$
Choice of the nearby value
Take $f(x)=\sqrt{x}$ and $a=36$. Then
$$f(36)=6$$
Derivative at the nearby value
$$f'(x)=\frac{1}{2\sqrt{x}}$$
Therefore,
$$f'(36)=\frac{1}{12}$$
Application of the approximation
Since $36.5-36=0.5$,
$$\sqrt{36.5}\approx6+\frac{1}{12}(0.5)=6+\frac{1}{24}$$
Conclusion
Thus, $\sqrt{36.5}\approx6.0417$ correct to four decimal places.
